newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar backs off highs, NY rally falter.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar backs off highs, NY rally falter.

text.p: White sugar futures maintained their firmness throughout afternoon activity on Tuesday but lost some of their upside momentum as the expected surge on the raws market failed to materialise.

London's spot August contract broke through nearby resistance at $317.50 without too much trouble and traders said they had expected the price to rally further once July raws hit buy stops at 11.10 cents/lb.
But although both markets stayed firm and July managed to reach 11.14, the nearby contracts backed off intraday highs in both whites and raws.
London's August and October contracts moved broadly in tandem, keeping the nearby spread roughly steady at $11.00.
August/October was also supported by commission house purchases and has widened from $8.00 in a matter of days.
Traders said while there was probably more upside potential for August whites, a correction would have to come as physical buyers would just wait for lower prices.
"I suspect there will be a correction," said one trader, adding that August could rally to as high as $325 before edging lower again.
"I don't think the substance is there in the August."
At 1520 GMT August dominated the day's volume, standing $1.30 higher at $317.90 after hitting a high of $318.30. October was up 80 cents at $307.00.
Paris trading remained subdued with just 127 lots on the board. August was up $1.20 at $318.00 and October was untraded.
